title: Ondo tunnel hero
description: A white hero 125% of the window tall: a two-part headline split around a square media frame made of three concentric rounded squares (a tunnel of nested videos), side by side on desktop and stacked word-frame-word on phones, with a centred serif sentence below. On load the frames shrink in from screen-filling to their nested sizes while the two halves of the headline slide outwards from behind them; a small 'scroll to explore' hint gives way to the sentence, which fades up.
notes: media slots: three square frames (outer, middle, inner), e.g. three crops of one video for the tunnel effect; plain surfaces when empty
the serif sentence reads var(--ondo-serif) and falls back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-hero

props.name: lead
props.description: the headline's first half, left of (above) the frame

props.name: trail
props.description: the headline's second half, right of (below) the frame

props.name: text
props.description: the serif sentence under the frame

props.name: hint
props.description: a small hint shown while the hero loads in (e.g. "Scroll to explore")

props.name: frames
props.description: the three frames, outer to inner (square videos or images). Plain surfaces when empty
